paite: Huan TOUPA'N David kiang ah Nathan asawl hi. Akiang ah ava hoh a, hichi in achi, "Khua khat ah mi nih a-om ua; khat pen mihausa ahi a, khat pen mizawng ahi.
heading: Nathan Thugen Leh David Kisikna

paite: Mihausa in belamhon tampi leh ganhon tampi anei hi.

Mizawng in bel belamnou anu neuchik khat lei a, avulh kia lou ngal bangmah dang anei kei hi. Amah leh atate toh khangliankhawm in akuang sawkpih leh anou kikoppih, a-angsung a om, atanu bang geih a angaihtuah ahi.
Mihausa kiang ah khualzinmi khat ava tung hi. Akiang a mikhual tung ama belam leh gan goh ding phal lou in mizawngpa belamnou leh ganhon a pan agohsak zawta hi," achi hi.
Huchi in huai mi tung ah David aheh mahmah a, Nathan kiang ah, "TOUPA ahin bang in ka gen ahi, huai thilhihmi asih ngeingei ding ahi.
Hichibang thil ahih ziak leh hehpihna aneih louh ziak in abelamnou amun li a adit ding ahi," achi hi.
Nathan in David kiang ah, "Huai mipa nangmah na hi. TOUPA, Israelte’ Pathian in hichi in achi: Israelte kumpipa ding in thau ka hon nilh a, Saul khut a pan ka hon hunkhia hi.
Na pu in ka hon luahsak a, na pu zite na angsung ah ka koih hi. Israel leh Judah inkote ka hon pia a; huaite atawm luat uleh thil dangte leng hon piakbeh lai ding ka hi.
Bangziak a TOUPA thupiak ngaineu a, amitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih maizen? Hit mi Uriah namsau in na that a, azi na zi ding in na neihsak a, Ammon suante namsau in amah na that hi.
Huaiziak in namsau in na insung anuse ngei nawn kei ding. Kei hon ngaineu a, Hit mi Uriah zi na zi dia na lak ziak in.

TOUPA'N hichi in achi: Ngai in, nangmah inkote mah nang kalh ding thil hoih lou ka tungkhe dia, na mitmuh mahmah in na zite ka hon laksak dia, na inveng ka pe dia, ama'n hiai sun khovak in na zite akithuahpih ding.
Nang aguk in na hih a, ke'n Israel mite tengteng mitmuh in sun khovak in ka hih ding," achi hi.
David in Nathan kiang ah, "TOUPA tung ah ka khialta," achi hi. Nathan in David kiang ah, "TOUPA'N leng na khelhna akoihmangta. Na si kei ding.
Himahleh hiai na thilhih a Pathian gensiatna dia hun lemtang thupitak TOUPA melmate na piak ziak in nang a pan hong piang ding naupang asi ngeingei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in Nathan in a-inn ah apaisanta hi. Uriah zi in David asuansak naupang tung ah TOUPA'N akhut kha in, achi ana mahmahta hi.
heading: David Tapa Sihna

paite: Huaiziak in David in naupang a ding in Pathian kiang ah angen ngutngut a, an angawl a, alut a, zankhua in lei ah alum hi.
A-inkote lak a upate athou ua, lei a pan kaithou ding in akiang ah adingh uhi. Himahleh athou nuam kei a, akiang uah leng ane sam kei.

Huan hichi ahong hi a, ani sagih ni in naupang asita hi. David sikhate'n naupang asita chih ahilh ngam kei uh, "Ngai in, naupang adam lai in akiang ah thu i gen ua, angaikhe nuam kei a. Naupang asita chih bangchi in i hilh ngamta ding ua? Bangchi hiam in thil hoih lou akihih kha ding," achi uhi.
Himahleh David in asikhate kisimhou amuh in naupang asita chih atheita hi. David in asikhate kiang ah, "Naupang sita hia?" achi a, amau, "Asita,” achi uh.
Huchi in David lei a pan athou a, akisil a, sathau akinilh a, apuante akheng a; TOUPA' inn ah ahoh a, Pathian abia hi. A-inn ah apai nawn a, an akan a, ama ah alui ua, aneta hi.
Huchi in asikhate'n akiang ah, "Na thilhih bangchidan ahia? Naupang adam lai in an na ngawl a, na kap a, himahleh naupang asihtak in na thou a, an na ne a," achi uhi.
Ama'n, "Naupang adam lai in an ngawl in ka kap hi. Naupang adamna ding in TOUPA'N hon hehpih khamoh kei ding chih kua ahia thei? Ka chi hi.
Himahleh tu in asita ngal a, bang ding in an ka ngawl dia? Ka pikik nawn thei dia hia? Akiang ah ka pai dia, himahleh amah ka kiang ah ahong kik nawn kei ding," achi hi.
Huchi in David in azi Bathsheba alungmuan a, akiang ah alut a, akithuahpih a, tapa asuang a, amin Solomon asa hi. TOUPA'N amah a-it hi.
heading: Solomon Pianna

paite: Huchi in zawlnei Nathan athukhak a, ama'n TOUPA ziak in amin Jedidiah asa hi.
Huchi in Joab in Ammon suante khopi Rabbah sim in alata hi.
heading: David In Rabbah Ala / (1 Kro 20.1-3)

paite: Joab in David kiang ah mi asawl a, "Rabbah ka sim a, tuite khopi ka lata hi.
Tu in mi om lai teng kaikhawm inla, khopi sual tum in zuan inla, la in. Ke'n khopi la leng ka min apu kha ding," achi hi.
Huchi in David in mi tengteng akaikhawm a, Rabbah ah ahoh ua, ava sim ua, alata uhi.
Akumpipa uh lallukhu khuk lai alaksak a, agikdan dangka-eng talent khat ahi a, suangmantamte leng atel hi. David akhusak ua, khopi ah gallak tampi ala uhi.

Huchi in asung a om mipite apikheta a, sing-atnate, leilehna sikzumte leh sik heipite zang in nna asemsak hi. Lei haltakte abawlsak a; Ammon suante khopi tengteng ah huchibang in ahih hi. Huchi in David leh mi tengteng Jerusalem ah apaikik nawnta uhi.
